name: AnyWhere
subtitle: Change your iPhone's location, privately.
description: AnyWhere sets your iPhone's GPS location: teleport, drive a route with stops, or steer with a joystick. Add this source in SideStore to get updates and keep AnyWhere refreshed on the iPhone, with no computer.

apps.name: AnyWhere
apps.subtitle: Change your iPhone's location, privately.
apps.localizedDescription: Teleport anywhere, drive a route on real roads with rest stops, or steer with a joystick. The iPhone-only mode needs a pairing file and LocalDevVPN.

versions.localizedDescription: AnyWhere 1.2. See the release notes on GitHub.

privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: AnyWhere finds your Mac on this network, and in the iPhone-only mode reaches this iPhone's own developer services.
privacy.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Shows where iOS reports this iPhone to be, so you can check the simulated location. In the iPhone-only mode it also keeps AnyWhere running while it holds a location.
